error.anal.abundance: Engine error for the formula analysis; {label} = the element symbol with no natural abundances in the table.
error.grafo.cut.mode: Engine error message; {mode} = type of cleavage requested.
err.http: Network error without details; {status} = HTTP code.
error.fixedLimit: A fixed limit of the program (not memory): {what} = the part of the file, English words from the engine; {limit_mb} = the limit in MB.
err.engine.indexWhy: The index of a file could not be built. {name} = file name, {detail} = technical cause.
err.engine.indexCrash: The worker that builds the index died (usually memory). {name} = file name.
err.dam.unreadable: Shown in the method window; {message} = technical text (English).
err.map.region: Map API error: region with inverted ends.
err.formula.element: {element} = symbol, {formula} = formula written by the user.
err.comp.many: {n} = number of combinations of the elements other than C and H; {max} = fixed limit (3000000). Error for a single m/z: the other features go on.
err.load.cancelled: The loading of a file was stopped with "Cancel" (the file row already says so: the text does not repeat the name).
warn.convert.fewerWorkers: Calm conversion notice (CLI and desktop app queue): the memory budget allows fewer simultaneous conversions. {workers} = simultaneous conversions, {wanted} = the default ones (cores-1, max 4), {budget_mb} = computer budget in MB.
err.conv.mzlabNoProfile: Error of convert with peaks = mzlab (CLI, app) on a file that has only the vendor centroids: mzLab does not write the instrument centroids as its own.
warn.centroid.widthFallback: Warning of the spectra.centroid step (Flow, CLI and site): the width is not measured but a fallback; never call it estimated.
warn.centroid.merged: Warning of the spectra.centroid step (Flow, CLI and site): centroids with the MERGED flag (full width at half maximum over 1.12 times that of the file at their m/z); a warning, not an answer.
warn.agilent.damaged: Calm partial-read notice (CLI, flow, loading row): damaged scan records of an Agilent .D folder (without time, points outside the data file, data.ms records that do not fit): their scans are left out and counted. Do not say that the file ends.
warn.bruker.noCalibration: Calm partial-read notice (CLI, flow, loading row): frames of a .d folder without a usable MzCalibration; their spectra are left out and counted because their m/z cannot be calculated. Do not say that the file ends.
error.featMemory: Tabui (pipeline) error: a stage does not fit in memory. {fase} = stage (align, proofs), {files} = number of files, {stima_mb} and {budget_mb} = estimated memory and budget in MB.
error.fileInUse: Error: the file has been written by another mzLab tab for more than 2 seconds. {file} = file name.
err.manint.columns: Error of the manual integrations table for an unknown optional column group; {column} = name requested.
err.manint.baseline: Error of the manual integrations table for an unknown baseline; {baseline} = name requested.
err.sample.list: Error message of --sample and the site's sample selection; {text} = the text given.
err.sample.unknown: Error message of --sample and the site's sample selection; {missing} = requested sample ids not in the file, {ids} = the sample ids the file has.
err.sample.single: Error message of --sample of the convert CLI when no input has several samples.
meta.mancante: Entry of metodo/1.avvisi: an expected part that the file does not have (log, method). {dove} = the part.
meta.danneggiato: Warning of the metodo/1 document: an auxiliary table (metadata, TIMS calibration, method properties) is damaged; {dove} = file and table. The scans are read.
meta.ioneScartata: Entry of metodo/1.avvisi of the .raw: the monoisotopic ion of the trailer falls outside the isolation window and the target is used. {dove} = count of the scans, text from the reader.
meta.daTabella: Entry of metodo/1.avvisi of the .raw: a value taken from the method (SRM transitions table) and not from the individual scan. {dove} = what and how many scans, text from the reader.
err.formula.offset: Engine error message; {offset} = the offset written by the user, with its sign.
err.formula.mzLow: Engine error message; {mz} = m/z (below 1) that would give the offset written.
error.drift.tooFewQc: Engine error message; {batch} = batch, {have} = how many there are, {need} = how many are needed.
error.etich.element: Engine error message (drawing labels); {label} = atom label in Ketcher.
error.etich.isotope: Engine error message (drawing labels); {label} = atom symbol with the isotope.
error.hypo.rulesVersion: Engine error message; {found} = version found, {need} = how many are needed.
error.generic: Error without its own text; {detail} = technical message from the engine.
